subject: URGENT: Your account will be suspended
message: We detected unusual activity on your account. You must verify your account immediately or access will be suspended today. Click the verification link to continue.
explanation: This is phishing. The message creates urgency, threatens account suspension, and asks the user to verify through an unexpected link.

subject: Reminder: Staff meeting tomorrow
message: Hello team, this is a reminder that the monthly staff meeting will take place tomorrow at 10:00 AM in Conference Room B. Please contact the office if you have any questions.
explanation: This example does not contain obvious phishing indicators. It provides routine information without requesting sensitive information or suspicious actions.

subject: Payment information needs attention
message: Your payment information could not be confirmed. Please review your account immediately using the link provided in this message.
explanation: This is phishing. The sender address is suspicious, the message creates concern about payment information, and it encourages the user to use an unexpected link.

subject: Community newsletter
message: This month's community newsletter is now available. You can read the latest announcements during your next visit to the official community website.
explanation: There is no obvious request for sensitive information or urgent action. The message directs users to the official website rather than asking them to follow an unexpected login link.
